blocks.text: Renata Castillo
Reno, NV | (775) 555-0163 | renata.castillo@example.com
Summary

Second-shift operations supervisor at a 400,000-square-foot distribution center, with 10 years in warehouse work. Opened a cross-dock in Fernley, NV and took its on-time shipping from 79% to 98% within five months. Moved up at Tumbleweed Home Goods from warehouse associate to lead to shift supervisor over 35 associates.
Experience
Opened the Fernley, NV cross-dock in March 2022 and ramped its on-time shipping from 79% to 98% by August 2022.
Built the cross-dock's shift schedule and trained its first 18 associates.
Supervise 35 warehouse associates on second shift in a 400,000-square-foot distribution center.
Kept inventory accuracy at 99.6% through 2023 and 2024 by running weekly cycle counts.
Cut mis-picks from 1.2% to 0.4% by adding a second scan at pack-out in Manhattan WMS.
Led a receiving team of 12 and set its daily putaway plan.
Trained 40 new associates on Manhattan WMS scanners and putaway rules.
Picked, packed and received freight, and moved up to lead after two years.
Education
High School Diploma | Reno, NV | 2014
Certifications
OSHA 10-Hour General Industry | 2021
Forklift Certification, sit-down and reach truck operator | 2017
Skills
Manhattan WMS (warehouse management system), cycle counts, shift scheduling, putaway planning
